turns.user_utterance: I have a duplicate payment showing up on the app. How do I stop myself being charged for the thing twice?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—if you’re seeing the same purchase charged twice, the fastest way is to check whether the payments are both completed or if one is pending, then we can help you file the right duplicate-charge case. Can you confirm: are both charges marked as “completed” (or one “pending”)? Also, do they have the same merchant name and amount?
